meta.name: humanize
meta.description: This skill should be used when writing or revising text, including responses, documentation, comments, emails, posts, reports, and messages, especially when the user asks to "humanize", "write naturally", "remove AI tone", or "avoid AI writing".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除AI腔,让文字像真人写的一样
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常被AI生成痕迹明显的文字困扰,希望表达更自然。
copy.tagline_en: Rewrite any text to sound naturally human.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're often bothered by AI-sounding text and want more natural expression.

howto.what: 改写文字使它更接近人类写作：删掉空话和重复结论，把含糊的夸赞换成具体事实，用简单句，避免AI常见词和固定结构，并配合用户的口吻和正式程度。
howto.when: 当用户请它写或改文字（如回复、文档、评论、邮件等），尤其当用户要求“humanize”、“write naturally”、“remove AI tone”等表达时触发。

say.text: 把这段话改得像人写的，去掉AI腔。
say.note: 触发全文改写，简化表达。

say.text: 删掉“总而言之”“此外”这类套话，保留事实。
say.note: 会移除堆砌的过渡和空话。

say.text: 用简单句子重写，把“彰显了重要作用”改成具体事实。
say.note: 会更直接，避免空泛评价。

howto.what_en: Rewrites text to sound more human: removes filler and repeated conclusions, replaces vague praise with concrete facts, uses simple sentences, avoids common AI words and stock phrases, and matches the user's tone and formality level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for writing or revising text (replies, documents, comments, emails, etc.), especially when they say "humanize", "write naturally", "remove AI tone", or similar.

say_en.text: Make this sound more human and less like AI.
say_en.note: Prompts a full rewrite in plainer language.

say_en.text: Remove filler phrases like 'Moreover' and 'In conclusion' and keep the facts.
Rewrite this in simple sentences and replace vague claims with specifics.
say_en.note: Makes the writing more direct and concrete.
